articles.title: Houthis bombardeiam área do palácio presidencial no Iêmen | G1
articles.standfirst: Ataque do grupo terrorista iemenita é uma escalada na guerra travada contra forças governamentais do Iêmen, que são apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita.
articles.summary: Ataque do grupo terrorista iemenita é uma escalada na guerra travada contra forças governamentais do Iêmen, que são apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita.
articles.body:
O grupo terrorista Houthi bombardeou o complexo do palácio presidencial do Iêmen em Áden, no sul do país. O governo iemenita afirmou que o ataque matou dois seguranças, mas que primeiro-ministro está seguro.

Os Houthis utilizaram mísseis e drones no ataque, que atingiu um local próximo ao palácio presidencial e matou dois seguranças , afirmaram duas fontes do governo iemenita à agência de notícias Reuters.

O primeiro-ministro do Iêmen e integrantes do gabinete que estavam no complexo do palácio presidencial de Maashiq não ficaram feridos , afirmou o ministro da Informação, Moammar al-Eryani.

O ministro disse ainda que os Houthis dispararam cinco mísseis contra o local. Testemunhas afirmaram à agência Associated Press (AP) que ouviram ao menos seis explosões de grande magnitude.

Segundo a AP, duas das explosões ocorreram perto do topo da colina onde fica o Palácio Al-Mashiq, e o restante ocorreu perto do portão do complexo presidencial.

A agência de notícias Saba, controlada pelos Houthis, citou um militar que alegou que o grupo tinha como alvos um quartel-general de operações militares comandado por oficiais sauditas no complexo , além de depósitos de armas.

Um porta-voz militar dos Houthis, que são financiados pelo Irã, alegou que o ataque desta quinta foi contra o que descreveu como um quartel-general de operações militares sauditas em Áden, e que a investida integrava a política declarada do grupo de “atacar concentrações militares sauditas onde quer que estejam”.

O ataque desta quinta ocorre na esteira de uma guerra de duas frentes travada pelos Houthis contra a Arábia Saudita e contra as forças do governo internacionalmente reconhecido do Iêmen —que são aliados dos sauditas. Esse conflito voltou a aquecer recentemente por conta da guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irã, e vem se expandindo ao longo das últimas semanas.

articles.title: Papa Leão XIV nomeia dom Andreolli bispo da diocese de Ponta de Pedras | G1
articles.standfirst: Italiano e missionário Xaveriano, ele atuava como bispo auxiliar da arquidiocese de Belém. CNBB enviou saudação ao novo bispo.
articles.summary: Italiano e missionário Xaveriano, ele atuava como bispo auxiliar da arquidiocese de Belém. CNBB enviou saudação ao novo bispo.
articles.body:
Papa Leão XIV nomeia dom Paulo Andreolli bispo da diocese de Ponta de Pedras, no Marajó. — Foto: Reprodução / Arquidiocese de Belém

O Papa Leão XIV nomeou, nesta quinta-feira (15), dom Paulo Andreolli bispo da diocese de Ponta de Pedras , no arquipélago do Marajó, no Pará. Com a nomeação, ele deixa o ofício de bispo auxiliar da arquidiocese de Belém.

Dom Paulo é italiano, missionário Xaveriano e se dedica ao trabalho pastoral, missionário e vocacional, com forte presença no Brasil, especialmente no Pará. Com a nomeação, ele se tornou o quarto bispo da diocese de Ponta de Pedras.

A Conferência Nacional dos Bispos do Brasil (CNBB) enviou saudação ao religioso. Na mensagem, a entidade afirmou que recebeu a notícia "com alegria" e expressou o desejo de que a nova etapa do pastoreio "fortaleça ainda mais a sua presença como discípulo missionário a serviço do povo de Deus do norte do nosso país".

Dom Paulo Andreolli nasceu em 16 de dezembro de 1972, em Pojana Maggiore, Vicenza, na Itália. É filho de Mario Andreolli e Giuliana Conte e tem duas irmãs, Elena e Laura.

Aos 11 anos, em 1984, ingressou no Seminário Xaveriano de Vicenza, onde concluiu o ensino médio. Entre 1992 e 1994, realizou o noviciado em Ancona e, em seguida, estudou filosofia e teologia na Casa Mãe dos Xaverianos, em Parma.

Ele fez os votos perpétuos em 5 de março de 2000, virou diácono no dia seguinte e se tornou padre em 17 de setembro de 2000.

A primeira destinação pastoral foi na comunidade formativa de Desio, em Milão, na Itália, onde atuou como animador vocacional e missionário. No período, cursou pós-graduação em espiritualidade e acompanhamento espiritual na Faculdade da Itália Setentrional, em Milão.

Em 17 de novembro de 2007, foi enviado ao Brasil. Atuou no Pará como vigário paroquial por cinco anos na cidade de São Félix do Xingu e como pároco por quatro anos em Tucumã, na atual Prelazia do Alto Xingu – Tucumã, com intensa dedicação aos jovens.

A partir de 2017, seguiu na missão como animador vocacional e missionário na região do Pará, com atuação na comunidade formativa de Ananindeua e junto ao Conselho Missionário Regional – Pará e Amapá (COMIRE). Também atuou como conselheiro regional dos Xaverianos e colaborou com a Conferência dos Religiosos do Brasil (CRB – Subnúcleo 2), em Belém.

Em 1º de fevereiro de 2023, o Papa Francisco nomeou padre Paulo Andreolli bispo auxiliar da arquidiocese de Belém do Pará, e atribuiu a ele também o título de bispo titular de Altava.

A ordenação episcopal aconteceu em 15 de abril de 2023, na catedral metropolitana de Belém, em cerimônia presidida por dom Alberto Taveira Corrêa, arcebispo de Belém. Com a consagração, ele se tornou o oitavo bispo auxiliar da arquidiocese.

articles.title: Governo suspende autorizações para queimadas por 15 dias em Roraima | G1
articles.standfirst: Medida proíbe temporariamente uso do fogo em áreas rurais para tentar conter incêndios devido à estiagem causada pelo fenômeno El Niño. Femarh monitora descumprimentos.
articles.summary: Medida proíbe temporariamente uso do fogo em áreas rurais para tentar conter incêndios devido à estiagem causada pelo fenômeno El Niño. Femarh monitora descumprimentos.
articles.body:
Autorizações para queimadas em Roraima são suspensas por 15 dias, devido ao El Ni — Foto: Diane Sampaio/PMBV

O governo de Roraima suspendeu as autorizações para uso do fogo controlado no estado . A medida foi anunciada em coletiva nesta quinta-feira (15), em Boa Vista e vale por 15 dias . A restrição visa frear os incêndios durante a seca extrema que atinge o estado .

Com a decisão, as licenças para produtores rurais usarem o fogo para limpar pastos e áreas de plantio ficam paralisadas . O Comitê Estadual de Queimadas tomou a decisão por unanimidade . O grupo deve reavaliar o cenário em dez dias para definir os próximos passos, conforme a evolução do clima.

O presidente da Fundação Estadual do Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos (Femarh), Wagner Severo, reforçou que, com o calendário suspenso temporariamente, qualquer tipo de queimada passa a ser considerada crime ambiental .

"A partir desse período, todos os focos de calor que forem detectados serão considerados ilegais, e aí serão adotadas as medidas administrativas cabíveis, do ponto de vista cível e penal", afirmou Severo.

Para identificar infratores, a Femarh vai usar um sistema de monitoramento que cruza a localização dos incêndios com o Cadastro Ambiental Rural (CAR). Na prática, o governo consegue saber exatamente em qual propriedade o fogo começou e quem é o dono da terra.

Segundo Severo, o objetivo da suspensão rigorosa é evitar que Roraima chegue à mesma situação de emergência do estado vizinho, o Amazonas.

O estado enfrenta uma alta expressiva nos incêndios . O Instituto Nacional de Pesquisas Espaciais (Inpe) registrou 174 focos de calor apenas nas duas primeiras semanas de outubro . O número é 248% maior que o registrado no mesmo período do ano passado. Roraima já acumula 2.149 focos de calor em 2026 .

Rorainópolis , Pacaraima e Caracaraí lideram os registros de queimadas neste mês. A combinação de fogo e estiagem prolongada preocupa as autoridades e agrava os danos ambientais.

O meteorologista da Fundação Estadual do Meio Ambiente e Recursos Hídricos (Femarh), Ramon Alves, explicou que o estado enfrenta um fenômeno El Niño de categoria "muito forte" , um dos mais intensos registrados desde 1950.

"Além do nosso período seco, que já é intenso e começa agora em outubro, nós estamos acumulando esse fenômeno. As precipitações diminuíram bastante", destacou o especialista. Em agosto, por exemplo, choveu apenas 19 milímetros no estado, quando a média histórica é de 200 milímetros.

O impacto da falta de chuvas também é visível nos rios . O coordenador estadual da Defesa Civil, coronel Anderson Carvalho de Matos, informou que o nível do rio Branco chegou a apenas 52 centímetros de profundidade .

"O nosso rio baixou 1,60 metro nestes primeiros 15 dias de outubro. É muita coisa. Se seguirmos a tendência para os próximos sete dias, ele deve baixar mais 25 centímetros", alertou o coronel.

Para tentar reduzir os danos, o governo vai instalar quatro bases avançadas de fiscalização no interior a partir da próxima segunda-feira (19). O foco atual é orientar produtores rurais e atuar na prevenção, com apoio de associações e prefeituras.

A seca, intensificada pelo fenômeno El Niño, afeta diretamente a economia local. A Associação dos Produtores de Soja de Roraima (Aprosoja) projeta uma perda de 50% na produtividade da atual safra de grãos. O estado está em situação de emergência desde setembro .

Medida que suspende queimadas no estado foi anunciada em coletiva nesta quinta-feira (15). — Foto: Naamã Mourão/Rede Amazônica

Para reduzir os impactos da seca, a Companhia de Águas e Esgotos de Roraima (Caer) anunciou a perfuração de novos poços de água no estado . Em Boa Vista, a empresa planeja instalar uma bomba extra no rio Branco caso o nível da água chegue a uma situação crítica. Atualmente, a capital é abastecida por três estações de tratamento e 110 poços.

No interior, a distribuição deve ganhar o reforço de caminhões-pipa e novas estruturas de captação. As medidas incluem municípios como Rorainópolis, Caroebe e Pacaraima, além das vilas Félix Pinto (Cantá) e Vista Alegre (Caracaraí).

Na área da saúde, a Secretaria de Estado da Saúde (Sesau) prepara a rede de atendimento para os efeitos da fumaça e da estiagem. O foco é garantir o tratamento de pacientes com desidratação, doenças respiratórias e queimaduras.

Leia outras notícias do estado no g1 Roraima .

articles.title: JAC2 entrevista candidatos ao governo do estado no 2º turno; confira
articles.summary: Rede Amazônica e g1 transmitem, ao vivo, as sabatinas com os candidatos ao governo do Acre, entre os dias 15 e 16 de outubro.
articles.body:
Rede Amazônica e g1 transmitem, ao vivo, as sabatinas com os candidatos ao governo do Acre, entre os dias 15 e 16 de outubro.

A sabatina com os candidatos ao governo do Acre segue na próxima sexta-feira (16). A entrevistada será Mailza Assis (PP), segundo a ordem do sorteio realizado.

O candidato Alan Rick (Republicanos) cancelou a participação na sabatina desta quinta-feira (15), no JAC2. Em nota, a assessoria informou que ele teve conflitos na agenda.

"Agradecemos o convite e a dedicação da equipe da Rede Amazônica na organização das entrevistas. Reconhecemos a importância desse trabalho para que os acreanos conheçam as propostas dos candidatos e lamentamos a impossibilidade de participação", destacou.

Durante as entrevistas, os candidatos poderão apresentar propostas e programas de governo, além de discutir temas de interesse do estado.

Entre 15 e 16 de outubro, a Rede Amazônica Acre entrevista os dois candidatos ao governo do Acre no 2º turno das eleições 2026. A ordem dos entrevistados foi definida por sorteio e cada entrevista terá duração de 30 minutos.

articles.title: Ex-IAS Divya Mittal launches own party: 10 civil servants who quit service to enter politics
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal on Thursday launched the Jan Neeti Bharat party and announced that it would contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Former IAS officer Divya Mittal on Thursday launched the Jan Neeti Bharat party and announced that it would contest the 2027 Uttar Pradesh assembly elections. Her announcement comes nearly a month after she took voluntary retirement from the civil services, ending a 13-year administrative career to pursue politics independently.In a video message on X, Mittal said the party will focus on making people central to policymaking and ensuring that the government remains accountable to them throughout its five-year term, rather than only on election day."Politics rules over you. In Jan Neeti, you will be the ones who rule," she said, announcing the party's name and its decision to contest the state polls due early next year.Her decision to launch a party of her own places her among a group of civil servants who left government service before their scheduled retirement to enter politics.Here are 10 former civil servants who made the transition from bureaucracy to politics before completing their service.1. Yashwant SinhaYashwant Sinha resigned from the Indian Administrative Service in 1984 to enter active politics. He joined the Janata Party and subsequently became associated with the Janata Dal before joining the BJP.Sinha first served as Union finance minister in the Chandra Shekhar government in 1990-91. Under Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, he returned to the finance ministry in 1998 and held the portfolio until 2002, when he became external affairs minister.His political career also included membership of the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha. Sinha later distanced himself from the BJP and joined the Trinamool Congress in 2021, before contesting the 2022 presidential election as the opposition's joint candidate.2. Ajit JogiAjit Jogi left the IAS in 1986 to enter politics and joined the Congress. He had served as a district collector before moving into political life and was subsequently elected to the Rajya Sabha.Jogi's biggest political breakthrough came in 2000, when Chhattisgarh was carved out of Madhya Pradesh. He became the newly created state's first chief minister, holding office until 2003.After years in the Congress, Jogi broke away from the party in 2016 and founded the Janata Congress Chhattisgarh, seeking to establish an independent regional political platform.His career stands out as an example of a former administrator moving from district-level governance to the leadership of a newly formed state and later attempting to build a party of his own.3. Mani Shankar AiyarMani Shankar Aiyar resigned from the Indian Foreign Service in 1989 to enter politics. He had served as a diplomat for more than two decades and spent part of his career on deputation to the Prime Minister's Office under Rajiv Gandhi.Aiyar joined the Congress and won the Mayiladuthurai Lok Sabha seat in Tamil Nadu in 1991. He went on to become a prominent party leader and served as Union minister for petroleum and natural gas during the UPA government.He also held the panchayati raj portfolio and was involved in efforts to strengthen local self-government institutions.4. Arvind KejriwalArvind Kejriwal resigned from the Indian Revenue Service in 2006 after working in the income tax department. He had become involved in the Right to Information movement and founded the non-governmental organisation Parivartan to address citizens' grievances.His political journey gathered momentum during the Ana Hazare-led India Against Corruption movement, which campaigned for a stronger anti-corruption law. In 2012, Kejriwal founded the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP), choosing to build a political organisation rather than join an established party.AAP made its electoral debut in the 2013 Delhi assembly elections, when Kejriwal defeated then chief minister Sheila Dikshit. He became Delhi chief minister in December 2013 and returned to the post after the party's victories in 2015 and 2020.5. KJ AlphonsKJ Alphons took voluntary retirement from the IAS in 2006 and entered electoral politics in Kerala. He contested the Kanjirappally assembly seat in Kerala as an independent candidate supported by the Left Democratic Front and won.Alphons later founded the Jana Shakti platform before joining the BJP in 2011. His political journey subsequently took him to Parliament, when he became a Rajya Sabha member.In 2017, he was inducted into the Narendra Modi government as Union minister of state for tourism, with independent charge, and also handled electronics and information technology.His transition from a civil servant known for urban development initiatives to a state-level politician and Union minister is an example of an officer moving across political formations during his career.6. Satyapal SinghSatyapal Singh, a 1980-batch IPS officer of the Maharashtra cadre, opted for voluntary retirement in January 2014 while serving as Mumbai police commissioner, ahead of the Lok Sabha elections.He joined the BJP and contested the Baghpat Lok Sabha seat in Uttar Pradesh in 2014, defeating Rashtriya Lok Dal chief Ajit Singh. He retained the constituency in the 2019 general election.Singh served as Union minister of state for human resource development and water resources during the Modi government's first term. Before entering politics, he had served in several police leadership roles and was known for his work in law enforcement.7. OP ChoudharyOP Choudhary, a 2005-batch IAS officer, resigned from the service in 2018 while serving as Raipur collector to enter politics. He joined the BJP and contested the Kharsia assembly constituency in Chhattisgarh in the same year.Choudhary lost that election but returned to the electoral contest in 2023, this time winning the Raipur City South seat. He was subsequently inducted into the Chhattisgarh government as a minister.His career highlights the uncertain transition from administration to politics. Unlike officers who win their first election, Choudhary's initial defeat did not end his political ambitions. He returned five years later and secured a place in the state Cabinet.8. Aparajita SarangiAparajita Sarangi, a 1994-batch IAS officer of the Odisha cadre, took voluntary retirement in 2018 while serving as joint secretary in the Union rural development ministry.She joined the BJP in November that year and contested the 2019 Lok Sabha election from Bhubaneswar. Sarangi won the seat, defeating Biju Janata Dal candidate Arup Patnaik.She retained the constituency in the 2024 general election, establishing herself as a BJP leader in Odisha.Sarangi's transition was particularly swift: she moved from a senior central government position to an electoral contest within months of leaving the service and subsequently secured two consecutive Lok Sabha victories.9. AK SharmaAK Sharma, a 1988-batch IAS officer of the Gujarat cadre, took voluntary retirement in January 2021, around 18 months before his scheduled superannuation.Sharma had spent a substantial part of his career working in the Prime Minister's Office and was associated with Narendra Modi's administration during his tenure as Gujarat chief minister and later as prime minister.After leaving the service, Sharma joined the BJP and was elected to the Uttar Pradesh Legislative Council. He subsequently became a minister in the Yogi Adityanath government, handling portfolios including urban development and energy.His move demonstrated how a senior bureaucrat with experience in the central administration could enter state politics and secure a position in the Cabinet without first contesting a direct assembly election.10. Asim ArunAsim Arun, a 1994-batch IPS officer, took voluntary retirement in January 2022 while serving as Kanpur police commissioner. He joined the BJP soon afterwards, ahead of the Uttar Pradesh assembly elections.Arun contested the Kannauj assembly seat and won, entering a constituency associated with the Samajwadi Party. He was subsequently inducted into the Yogi Adityanath government.His political entry came within weeks of his voluntary retirement, making him one of the clearest recent examples of a serving police officer moving directly into electoral politics before the end of his career.Bonus: K AnnamalaiK Annamalai, a 2011-batch IPS officer of the Karnataka cadre, resigned from the police service in September 2019, before completing his tenure. He had served as superintendent of police in Udupi and Chikkamagaluru districts before leaving the force.He joined the BJP in August 2020 and rose rapidly through the party's ranks. In July 2021, he was appointed the BJP's Tamil Nadu president, becoming one of the party's most prominent faces in the state.Annamalai contested the 2021 Tamil Nadu assembly election from Aravakurichi but lost to the DMK's R Elango. In the 2024 Lok Sabha election, he contested from Coimbatore but lost to DMK candidate Ganapathi P Rajkumar.In June 2026, Annamalai quit the BJP following differences with the party leadership over its political strategy in Tamil Nadu and launched a new political movement, 'We The Leaders'. He said the movement would focus on "common man politics", challenge what he described as "cult and dynastic politics", and eventually evolve into a political party. He has outlined plans to contest the 2031 Tamil Nadu assembly elections.Get the latest India News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.

articles.title: China, Pakistan hold high-altitude army drills with Beijing-supplied arms
articles.summary: China and Pakistan launched their first joint army exercise in a high-altitude region of China's Xinjiang, with all weapons and military equipment used in
articles.body: China and Pakistan launched their first joint army exercise in a high-altitude region of China's Xinjiang, with all weapons and military equipment used in the drills supplied by Beijing, Chinese state media reported on Thursday.The exercise, named Karakoram 2026, began with an opening ceremony at a training base in Korla, in the Xinjiang Uygur autonomous region of northwestern China. The two countries have held annual joint air force and naval exercises, but this marks their first joint army training exercise, according to Chinese military officials.State-run CCTV reported that the drills involve several categories of Chinese military equipment, including Type 191 rifles, Type 201 squad machine guns, Type 11 armoured assault vehicles and Type 08 infantry fighting vehicles. Artillery systems, unmanned platforms and anti-drone systems have also been deployed.China is Pakistan's largest arms supplier, providing more than 80 per cent of the weapons supplied to the country's three armed services, according to the report.High-altitude drills highlight growing military cooperationThe deployment of Chinese equipment for high-altitude operations has drawn attention given China's military experience in the himalayan border region with India, according to the news agency PTI.Military affairs expert Wang Yunfei told the state-run Global Times that the use of medium-weight wheeled armoured vehicles in mountainous terrain reflected the operational considerations behind the exercise.According to Wang, wheeled armoured vehicles offer certain advantages over tracked platforms in high-altitude environments. They can move faster, particularly on roads, and are generally easier to maintain, making them suitable for transportation and combat missions across plateau terrain.He also noted that the use of Chinese equipment across multiple categories provided the participating forces with a relatively comprehensive combat system.The exercise demonstrates China's role in supplying military technology and equipment to Pakistan, Wang said. It could also help Islamabad assess the equipment for potential future purchases, further increasing the presence of Chinese-made systems in the Pakistan army.The drills therefore serve both as an opportunity for troops to familiarise themselves with the equipment and as preparation for closer operational cooperation.Wang added that the exercise reflected the high level of strategic trust between Beijing and Islamabad. Developing greater interoperability could support future joint activities involving counter-terrorism, border security and other military operations.Counter-terrorism operations form the core of the exerciseAccording to Chinese military officials, the exercise is focused on joint counter-terrorism operations and clearance missions in high-altitude areas.Senior Colonel Chen Xi, a spokesperson for China's ministry of National defence, said on Saturday that the programme would include training in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations, mobile target detection and firing, and long-range sniping.The exercise will also involve joint command activities and live-force training, according to the Chinese military.Military expert Zhang Jueshe told the global times that China and Pakistan had complementary capabilities in counter-terrorism, creating opportunities to deepen cooperation through intelligence sharing, joint operations, technology transfers and exchanges of operational experience.Zhang said China could provide Pakistan with technical assistance and equipment, including drones and intelligent combat platforms, to strengthen surveillance and early-warning capabilities against terrorist groups. Training and exchanges of counter-terrorism experience could also form part of the cooperation.At the same time, Pakistan's experience in managing complex border security challenges, dealing with local separatist groups and coordinating counter-terrorism operations could offer lessons for China in addressing similar non-traditional security threats, he added.Drills expected to strengthen China-Pakistan military tiesThe Karakoram 2026 exercise is expected to broaden military cooperation between the two countries, with a particular focus on counter-terrorism and high-altitude operations.Zhang said the drills would help strengthen mutual trust and improve coordination through the exchange of expertise and operational experience.The exercise also provides an opportunity for Chinese and Pakistani troops to practise working with common equipment and procedures, potentially improving their ability to operate together in future missions.The launch of the joint army drills marks a new phase in the two countries' military engagement, expanding cooperation beyond their established air force and naval exercises.You use AI every day. articles.title: Land surveyor arrested for accepting Rs 20k bribe
articles.summary: Vigilance Bureau arrests Purnia land surveyor Pramod Kumar Uraon for allegedly taking Rs 20,000 bribe for plot measurement; probe underway.
articles.body: Patna: The Vigilance Investigation Bureau (VIB) on Thursday arrested a govt land surveyor in Purnia district for allegedly accepting a bribe of Rs 20,000 to measure a plot of land, according to a bureau release. The VIB said land surveyor Pramod Kumar Uraon, posted at the Bhawanipur circle office, was caught allegedly accepting the bribe near the main gate of the Bhawanipur block office.The complainant, Vilas Sah, a resident of Madhavnagar, Ward 13, under Bhawanipur police station, had approached the VIB alleging that Uraon was demanding Rs 20,000 to carry out measurement of his land.The bureau said it verified the complaint and found the allegation prima facie true, following which a team was constituted under the supervision of Santosh Kumar, senior deputy superintendent of police, VIB, Patna, to conduct the trap. Uraon was subsequently arrested while allegedly accepting the money, the release said.The accused will be produced before the Special Vigilance Court in Bhagalpur after questioning.
